title: Finveritas
tagline: Explainable Financial Analytics Platform — Rank 1, PBL-2 Conclave 2026
body_md:
## Overview

Award-winning financial analytics platform built with a 7-agent LangGraph system, extracting 50+ financial metrics from Bloomberg PDFs for Basel III Pillar-2 compliance.

## Problem

Financial institutions struggle to explain AI decisions under Basel III Pillar-2 and RBI guidelines. Black-box models fail regulatory audits; manual analysis is error-prone and slow.

## Approach

Decoupled computation (Python) from narration (LLM) to achieve a 1.00 correctness score and 0.833 cross-reference coverage. Engineered a 7-agent LangGraph pipeline extracting 50+ financial metrics from Bloomberg PDFs.

## Technical Architecture

- **Agent Pipeline**: 7-agent LangGraph system for structured financial extraction
- **Metric Extraction**: 50+ BFSI metrics from Bloomberg PDFs
- **Compliance Engine**: Basel III Pillar-2 alignment with automated violation detection
- **Decoupling**: Python computation layer separate from LLM narration layer
- **Dashboard**: Executive-ready compliance reporting

## Outcomes

- **Rank 1 out of 20+ teams** at PBL-2 Industry Conclave 2026
- Judges: HDFC, SG Analytics, Tata Motors — live adversarial evaluation
- 1.00 correctness score · 0.833 cross-reference coverage
- Basel III Pillar-2 aligned

title: FORGE
body_md:
## Overview

Industrial audit and compliance platform built on a 5-model dbt data pipeline over DuckDB, processing 20,631 degradation cycles with full audit logging and automated risk escalation.

## Problem

Industrial systems lack structured audit trails and automated risk escalation for equipment degradation cycles. Manual compliance tracking is error-prone and lacks real-time visibility.

## Approach

Built a 5-model dbt pipeline over DuckDB processing 20,631 degradation cycles. Implemented 3-tier RBAC and automated risk escalation (≥ 0.70 threshold) with context-rich tracking using Docker and GitHub Actions.

## Technical Architecture

- **Data Pipeline**: 5-model dbt pipeline over DuckDB
- **Audit Logging**: Full audit trail for every degradation cycle
- **RBAC**: 3-tier role-based access control
- **Risk Escalation**: Automated alerts at ≥ 0.70 risk score with context
- **Infrastructure**: Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD

## Outcomes

- Processed 20,631 degradation cycles
- Full audit logging with context-rich tracking
- Automated risk escalation pipeline

title: ARGUS
body_md:
## Overview

AI governance gateway implementing JWT auth, PII masking (13 types via Presidio), XGBoost + SHAP risk scoring, and OPA/Rego rule enforcement with Redis rate limiting and per-tenant PostgreSQL budget tracking.

## Problem

As LLM adoption accelerates, organizations face growing regulatory pressure. Every AI request needs real-time policy enforcement, PII protection, and explainable risk scoring.

## Approach

Built a governance gateway that sits between applications and LLM providers. Implements JWT auth, masks 13 PII types via Microsoft Presidio, scores risk with XGBoost + SHAP, and enforces OPA/Rego policies with Redis rate limiting.

## Technical Architecture

- **Auth**: JWT authentication with per-tenant enforcement
- **PII Masking**: Microsoft Presidio — 13 PII types detected and redacted
- **Risk Scoring**: XGBoost + SHAP for explainable risk assessment
- **Policy Engine**: OPA/Rego for declarative governance rules
- **Rate Limiting**: Redis with per-tenant PostgreSQL budget tracking

## Outcomes

- 13 PII types masked in real-time
- Explainable risk scores via SHAP for every LLM interaction
- Per-tenant budget and rate limit enforcement

title: Lex Orion
body_md:
## Overview

Multi-agent courtroom simulation using role-based personas (Judge, Lawyer, Witness) grounded in the Indian Kanoon corpus via FAISS RAG, driving a 75% reduction in manual legal citation review time.

## Problem

Indian legal research requires extensive manual review of case law. Citation verification and legal argument construction are time-consuming and error-prone without structured AI assistance.

## Approach

Programmed a multi-agent system where each agent plays a specific courtroom role. The Indian Kanoon corpus is indexed via FAISS RAG, grounding all legal arguments in actual case law.

## Technical Architecture

- **Agent Roles**: Judge, Lawyer, Witness personas with distinct behavioral constraints
- **RAG Layer**: FAISS-indexed Indian Kanoon corpus for grounded legal citations
- **Orchestration**: Multi-agent coordination with conflict resolution
- **Output**: Structured legal briefs with verifiable citations

## Outcomes

- 75% reduction in manual legal citation review time
- Grounded in real Indian Kanoon case law corpus
- Role-based agent coordination for structured courtroom simulation
